sources.entry: QuotaBar - Local-first macOS menu bar app for tracking OpenAI Codex usage limits, reset countdowns, and optional alerts.

summary.one_liner: QuotaBar is a free, open-source native macOS menu bar app that shows remaining OpenAI Codex usage limits (5-hour and weekly windows) and reset countdowns.
summary.what_it_does: The app refreshes Codex usage every 60 seconds and displays remaining percentages for the 5-hour and weekly limits, plus any other limits the account returns. Left-clicking the menu bar icon opens a detailed panel, and right-clicking opens a menu with a usage summary, refresh, settings, and quit. An optional floating HUD can be shown or hidden with the ⌥⌘Q shortcut and remembers its position and screen. Users can opt in to system notifications for low quota thresholds or quota resets, and to a daily read of official OpenAI and GitHub RSS feeds. It signs in through the official Codex ChatGPT login flow and reads usage via the Codex App Server, without reading browser cookies or requiring an API key.
use_cases: check remaining Codex usage from the menu bar
monitor 5-hour and weekly ChatGPT Codex limits
get a notification when Codex quota runs low
keep a floating always-on-top usage widget on screen
copy a quick usage summary to share
how_to_run: Download QuotaBar-v1.1.0-macOS-arm64.zip from GitHub Releases and unzip it
Drag QuotaBar.app into the Applications folder
On first launch, Control-click the app, choose Open, and confirm
Sign in with ChatGPT or use demo mode
notable: Local-first: no developer backend, ad SDK, or analytics SDK; quota snapshots kept only in memory
Embeds a pinned Codex CLI so users do not need Node.js or npm installed
Floating HUD, native right-click status menu, and global ⌥⌘Q shortcut
Optional, opt-in official OpenAI and GitHub RSS feed reader limited to once per day
Includes a demo mode to preview the interface before logging in
caveats: Apple Silicon only, requires macOS 14 or later; no Intel build
GitHub download is ad-hoc signed and not notarized, so first launch needs manual confirmation
Download is about 84 MB because the Codex CLI is embedded
Notification permission may fail for preview builds; the README recommends the official Release build
